ticker.name: The Bank of New York Mellon Cor

business_summary: The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation provides a range of financial products and services in the United States and internationally. It operates through Securities Services, Market and Wealth Services, Investment and Wealth Management, and Other segments. The Securities Services segment offers custody, trust and depositary, accounting, exchange-traded funds, middle-office solutions, transfer agency, services for private equity and real estate funds, foreign exchange, securities lending, liquidity/lending services, and data analytics. This segment also provides trustee, paying agency, fiduciary, escrow and other financial, issuer, and support services for brokers and investors. The Market and Wealth Services segment offers clearing and custody, investment, wealth and retirement solutions, technology and enterprise data management, trading, and prime brokerage services. This segment also provides integrated cash management solutions, including payments, foreign exchange, liquidity management, receivables processing, payables management, and trade finance, as well as U.S. government and global clearing, and tri-party services. The Investment and Wealth Management segment offers investment management strategies, investment products distribution, investment management, custody, wealth and estate planning, private banking, investment, and information management services. The Other segment provides corporate treasury, derivative and other trading, corporate and bank-owned life insurance, tax credit investment, other corporate investment, and business exit services. The company serves central banks and sovereigns, financial institutions, asset managers, insurance companies, corporations, local authorities and high net-worth individuals, and family offices. The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation was founded in 1784 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
business_summary_ko: Bank of New York Mellon Corporation은 미국과 국제적으로 다양한 금융 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 증권 서비스, 시장 및 자산 서비스, 투자 및 자산 관리, 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 증권 서비스 부문은 보관, 신탁 및 예탁, 회계, 상장지수펀드, 미들오피스 솔루션, 이체 대행사, 사모펀드 및 부동산 펀드 서비스, 외환, 증권 대출, 유동성/대출 서비스 및 데이터 분석을 제공합니다. 이 부문은 또한 브로커와 투자자를 위한 수탁자, 지불 대행사, 수탁자, 에스크로 및 기타 금융, 발행자 및 지원 서비스를 제공합니다. 시장 및 자산 서비스 부문은 청산 및 보관, 투자, 자산 및 퇴직 솔루션, 기술 및 기업 데이터 관리, 거래 및 프라임 중개 서비스를 제공합니다. 이 부문은 또한 지불, 외환, 유동성 관리, 미수금 처리, 지불금 관리, 무역 금융은 물론 미국 정부 및 글로벌 청산, 삼자 서비스를 포함한 통합 현금 관리 솔루션을 제공합니다. 투자 및 자산 관리 부문은 투자를 제공합니다.
